basic_info.description:
Situated on the north west side of Grand Residence of Millennium feature an open floor plan with 10-foot height ceilings. Large two bedroom and two bathroom unit. 

Expansive windows spanned floor to ceiling showcasing views of Downtown, city and beyond. Upgraded engineering hardwood flooring leads to large dinning room, living room and Chef's kitchen with top-of-line appliance. Large bedrooms with plenty of natural light. The Master suite included multiple closets with lots of storage space. Dual vanity luxury Master bathroom feature glass shower area and large bathtub.

The 20,000 sq. ft. Owner's Club Level also includes: 5,500 square-foot Fitness Center, Screening Room, Pool Terrace, Wine Cellar, Tasting Room, Owner's Lounge, Dining Room, Children's Playroom, and Outdoor Terrace.

REDUCED RENT- $5,300/monthly, lease includes one car valet parking, one wine cellar storage, one storage space in basement. Gas, Water, Garbage and Sewer. 1.5 month security required.

Owner pays HOA, which including one valet parking, gas, water and garbage. Tenant is responsible for electricity, TV and internet
One valet parking right, One wine cellar storage and One additional storage space in basement are included in the rent.
